name: Bolt.new
shortDescription: In-browser AI web development agent powered by WebContainers that builds, runs, and deploys full-stack web applications.
description: Bolt.new is an AI-powered full-stack web development environment created by StackBlitz. Operating directly inside browser sandboxes via WebContainer technology, Bolt.new allows users to prompt, execute, debug, and deploy full-stack Node.js and web applications without local environment configuration.

pricing.details: Free plan includes daily token allocations; Pro plan starts at $20/month for higher token limits and custom LLM model selections.

features: Full-stack WebContainer environment executing Node.js applications directly in the browser
Automated package installation, terminal execution, and dev server orchestration
AI agent file editing, bug diagnosis, and live preview updates
One-click application deployment to Netlify and code export options
useCases: Rapid prototyping of modern full-stack web applications and React dashboards
Debugging complex npm package errors in an isolated browser sandbox
Generating responsive UI components with integrated frontend frameworks
limitations: Token usage caps on free tier require upgrading to Pro for heavy development loops
Browser WebContainer environment is limited to Node.js ecosystem capabilities

seo.title: Bolt.new — In-Browser AI Full-Stack Web Development Agent
seo.description: Build, run, and deploy full-stack web applications in your browser with Bolt.new by StackBlitz. Explore features, pricing, and open-source codebase.
